items.translation_en: In order to stimulate the development of investment and the domestic labour market in the Republic of Moldova and to remove the problems identified in normative acts by the working group "on stimulating the labour market" and described in the table of problems and solutions for stimulating the labour market, proposals were drafted to amend the regulatory frameworks (Art. 36^1(2), 43^1(8) and 43^2(5) of Law No. 200/2010 on the regime of foreigners, Law No. 274/2011 on the integration of foreigners, Art. 2(2), and the State Fee Law No. 1216/1992, Art. 2(3), Art. 3 point 3).
items.summary: To stimulate investment and the labour market, IGM proposed amendments to the law on foreigners, the integration law and the state fee law.

Scopul: facilitarea și promovarea procesului de integrare al străinilor prin însușir ea limbii de stat, facilitarea accesului la piața forței de muncă, precum și valorificarea întregului potențial ca membri ai societății. Cooperarea în cadrul Proiectului ,,Career Counseling and Protection of Labor Rights of Refugees” finanțat de către Danish Refugee Council.
items.translation_en: 26.01.2023: Memorandum of understanding between IGM and the Centre for Policies, Initiatives and Research Platforma, the National Association of European Trainers of Moldova, the National Employment Agency and the National Congress of Ukrainians in Moldova. Purpose: facilitating and promoting the integration of foreigners through learning the state language, facilitating access to the labour market and realising their full potential as members of society. Cooperation under the project "Career Counseling and Protection of Labor Rights of Refugees" funded by the Danish Refugee Council.
items.summary: On 26 January 2023 IGM, ANOFM and partners signed a memorandum to facilitate foreigners' labour market access, under a refugee career counselling project.
